name: sc
description: SwarmCloud from inside a Claude Code session. Two skills: `sc` reads the cluster -- the account pool and its quota windows, which pool actually binds each runner profile, what is running, what is wrong -- and never writes. `delegate` owns the decision to run work remotely instead of locally, dispatches it by runner-profile NAME from the frozen catalogue, reports a failure as something actionable rather than a task id, and brings the result back into the working tree. It writes, so it says when it asks first. Both require the swarm-mcp bridge in this repository.

deployment_url.title: SwarmCloud deployment URL
deployment_url.description: The address of YOUR SwarmCloud deployment -- the load balancer for a team deployment (e.g. https://swarm.example.com), or the *.run.app address for a solo one. Your platform operator knows it.

oauth_client_id.title: OAuth client ID (Desktop app)
oauth_client_id.description: The deployment's Desktop app OAuth client ID (ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com). Your operator creates one per deployment and allowlists it on IAP; with it you sign in as yourself with `sc login`. Leave empty for a solo deployment without IAP.

oauth_client_secret.title: OAuth client secret (Desktop app)
oauth_client_secret.description: The secret of that same Desktop app OAuth client (starts GOCSPX-). Stored in your system's secure credential store, never in settings.json. Leave empty for a solo deployment without IAP.
